blocks.orig: Go for a bike ride on the gorgeous tropical island of Zanzibar, and choose one of three routes: a ride from Stone Town to a spice farm and a forest, or one of two different village rides around Jambiani on the east coast. One of these includes a visit to Kuza Cave, which is the perfect place for a refreshing swim. With all tours explore Zanzibar’s lush country side, and get a feel for the still traditional and fascinating local life. A delicious local lunch is included in the tour!
blocks.html: Explore the beautiful tropical island of Zanzibar by bike, choosing from three routes: from Stone Town to a spice farm and a forest, or either of two village routes around Jambiani on the east coast. One of them stops at Kuza Cave, an ideal spot for a refreshing swim. Whichever tour you pick, you discover Zanzibar’s green countryside and get a sense of the fascinating local life, which is still very traditional. A tasty local lunch is part of the tour!
